newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end firmer, continue in recent range.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end firmer, continue in recent range.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled higher as prices continued their see-saw course ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's next supply and demand report next month.

November FCOJ closed up 1.40 cent a lb at 106.85, having ranged from 106.90 to 105.45. The remaining months closed 0.95 to 0.65 firmer, with several months left untraded. Volume on the day was estimated at only 1,100 lots.
The market awaits the weekly movement number, released after today's close. Players anticipated continued weakness, which may be already be reflected in current prices.
